_note: Casters are the caster and support archetypes (phase 3b, Decision 1): Cinder Moth and Gloam Witch in Act 1. The payoff (round 2): its own hits on them deal 20% more.
name: Casters first
text: Goes for the nearest enemy caster or support first, and hits them harder; with none standing, picks as usual.

_note: Lets go for good (phase 3b, Decision 2). The payoff (round 2): its attack runs 20% faster while it holds.
name: Hold your ground
text: Stays where it's placed, attacking faster at whatever is in reach, until an enemy comes within 2 hexes; then it moves out for the rest of the fight.

_note: The bar waits, full (phase 3b, Decision 3), until an ally is below 60% (Decision 5). Only a mana signature that heals the lowest ally can wait: Vell's Mend (Decision 4). The payoff (round 2): the heal it waited for is 15% stronger (R4 tuned it from 30%).
name: Wait to heal
text: Holds the healing signature, its bar full, until an ally in its reach is badly hurt; the heal it saved is stronger.
